name: sovereign-content-pipeline
description: 9-stage agency-grade pipeline. Skills enforced at every stage. Fails on weak concepts, QA < 80, or novelty violations.

stages.name: Strategy Agent
stages.skill_enforcement: content_engine_rules() + marketing_psychology_rules() injected into DeepSeek context

stages.name: Concept Agent
stages.skill_enforcement: Both injected. Concepts must use DISTINCT persuasion frameworks and layout families.

stages.name: Copy Agent + Localization
stages.skill_enforcement: brand_voice_rules() enforced. Every copy line annotated with [role] + [framework].
fail_if: cta_ar is empty or generic (contains 'اضغط هنا' / 'اعرف أكثر')

stages.name: Visual Plan Agent
stages.skill_enforcement: ALL 5 skill rule functions injected as mandatory constraints. Not decoration.

stages.name: DeepSeek Prompt Compiler
stages.skill_enforcement: DeepSeek generates 3 candidates, self-scores (constraint_compliance, novelty, anti_slop_risk), selects best 1-2. Cannot skip visual_plan constraints.
fail_if: selected prompt contains Arabic or Urdu text
selected prompt missing 'no text, no letters' suffix

stages.name: fal.ai Image Generation
stages.skill_enforcement: Platform dimensions from social-media-image-sizes. Negative prompt from anti-slop rules. NO text in image.
stages.note: Generate background ONLY. No text rendered here.

stages.name: Arabic/Urdu Overlay (RAQM preferred)
stages.skill_enforcement: editorial_typography_rules() enforced. RAQM path used when available. Reshaper fallback flagged in sidecar.
fail_if: arabic_reshaper used without RAQM AND text appears broken in output

stages.name: QA Agent — 6-check automated gate
stages.skill_enforcement: 5 automated checks run deterministically. Each maps to a specific skill rule. LLM only for brand-voice content check.
stages.on_fail: Return to 02_concept with blocking_reasons as feedback

stages.name: Multi-Platform Export
stages.skill_enforcement: All 6 platform sizes from social-media-image-sizes. Text reflows per responsive-layout.md safe areas. QA re-run at thumbnail size.
fail_if: text overflows safe area in any export size
stages.sidecar: Write {asset}--{platform}.json per export: sha256, dimensions, compliance_score, layout_family, style_family, contains_arabic, raqm_used

global_fail_conditions: Any required skill not invoked at its required stage
novelty_score below threshold (same layout+style used >= 2 times recently)
brand-voice rules violated (generic CTA, wrong dialect, banned words)
editorial-typography rules violated (Arabic not RTL, wrong font, too many words)
Arabic text baked into fal.ai prompt
human_gate: Human sign-off required before 09_multi_export executes. Asset visible in /inbox with all QA scores shown.
